verdict.summary: The script has notable performance issues: sequential GitHub API fetching (N+1 pattern) that could be parallelized, no rate limit handling, and no retry logic for transient failures. These cause latency scaling and failure risk under realistic load.
verdict.confidenceReason: The issues are clearly visible in the sequential for-loop fetching Phase 3 reviews and absence of retry/backoff code. Severity is moderate since the script has a --limit cap and is a one-time analysis tool, not production runtime.

findings.headline: Sequential GitHub API calls form an N+1 pattern
No retry logic for transient GitHub/KV failures
No GitHub API rate limit handling
findings.body:
GitHub API returns 403 with `Retry-After` header when rate limited. The code doesn't read this header or implement backoff. If the script hits rate limits, requests will fail rather than wait and retry. With --limit=30, the script makes up to 60 API calls (reviews list + comments per PR), which could approach unauthenticated limits (60/hr) if `GH_TOKEN` isn't properly applied.

**Fix**: Check `res.status === 403`, read `Retry-After`, and delay accordingly before retrying.

feat(phase4b): paired bake-off harness for ensemble vs Phase 3 comparison

## Summary

Step 2 of the Phase 4b roadmap (per [v3.1 LOCKED spec](https://github.com/Arc-and-Anchor/openclaw-worker/blob/main/.claude/handoff/arc-phase4-spec-v3.1-LOCKED.md)). Now that PR #35's shadow mode is live and ensemble telemetry is accumulating, this script lets us actually USE the data.

## What it does

Reads `ensemble-review-telemetry:*` records from prod KV, fetches the corresponding Phase 3 review FROM GitHub for each PR + SHA (Phase 3's PR-review path doesn't write KV — the review on GitHub IS the source of truth), joins by `{owner, repo, prNumber, headSha}`, and writes paired comparison records.

## Output

**Per pair (`bakeoff-runs/phase4-<runId>/<key>.json`):**
- Phase 3: review event/state/body + inline findings (path, line, side, score parsed from finding body)
- Phase 4: validated synth verdict, per-specialist verdicts, provenance, post-validation drop counts, retrieval cache stats, router decision
- Comparison: finding counts, max severity, `{path:line}` overlap, phase4-only / phase3-only counts, per-specialist contribution breakdown

**Aggregate (`_summary.json`):**
- Avg findings (both pipelines), avg overlap, avg phase4-only / phase3-only
- Count of PRs where each side caught a sev≥4 finding
- `delta_sev4plus_prs = phase4_sev4plus - phase3_sev4plus` — the headline "recall lift" metric the spec uses for the Phase 4b quality gate (≥30% lift target)

## Usage

```bash
OLLAMA_API_KEY=… \
CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=… \
CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=… \
GH_TOKEN=… \
node scripts/phase4-bakeoff.mjs --repo=arc-and-anchor/openclaw-worker --limit=30
```

Same auth pattern as `scripts/phase3-bakeoff.mjs` (Cloudflare REST API for KV with cursor pagination, GitHub PAT for reviews, explicit timeouts). No wrangler subprocess.

## Test plan

- [x] `node --check` passes
- [x] Env validation (rejects missing `CLOUDFLARE_*` / `GH_TOKEN`)
- [x] `--limit` validation (rejects `10abc` etc.)
- [x] `--limit=0` empty run completes clean
- [ ] After this PR merges + a few PRs accumulate telemetry: run with real creds, inspect output, validate comparison metrics make sense before Phase 4b Step 3 (human evaluation)

## What's NOT in this PR

- Auto-running comparison (this is a manual script — reviewers explicitly said no background job until we have a quality baseline)
- Headline-similarity matching (file+line is sufficient for the conservative first cut; downstream tooling can extend)
- Devstral A/B (Step 4 of Phase 4b roadmap, separate effort)
- Synthesizer retrieve-tool integration (Step 5, separate effort)

## Why this can ship before shadow data accumulates

The script doesn't need data to exist — it'll just print "nothing to compare — exiting clean." We write it ahead of time so it's ready to run the moment shadow records land. No reason to wait.
